function: Excluded (above_phy): the DDQN only chooses the split-inference mode (raw data or feature map) of each UAV task, an edge computing decision. p. 6: "the NN in DRL outputs the decision of transmission mode".
notes: Reason above_phy. p. 2: "TRL-based approach is utilized to determine whether split inference should be employed for processing tasks"; p. 6: action space of size 2, the transmission mode (direct transmission of raw data or computation-transmission of the feature map). The physical-layer decision, transmit power, is not learned: p. 9 "OP is used to optimize the transmit power in each time slot", solved in closed form by KKT (Theorem 1, p. 7) and ADMM over SAA samples (p. 8), so the clause on learned power control in aerial links does not apply. The baselines are "offloading policies" (p. 8). The UAV-to-server channel is a scalar coefficient g_t (p. 3), so the link is single-antenna. PDF is arXiv 2401.00445v1, Energy-Efficient Power Control for Multiple-Task Split Inference in UAVs: A Tiny Learning-Based Approach; it does not print the DOI.
